sources.name: Unicode CLDR
sources.version: 48.0 (as shipped in ICU 78.3 with Node 22.23.4; plural rules compared with cldr-json main on 2026-11-11)

provenance.notes: Conversions, month lengths, formatted strings, zone offsets and week data are computed with the ICU 78.3 / CLDR 48 / tzdata 2026e bundled in Node 22.23.4, not with this project's calendar data: they are a second opinion for the calendar layer, not the authority. Umm al-Qura dates follow ICU's table; an official announcement can differ by a day. Typed-date cases and their readings are written by hand.

data.purpose: Dates where interfaces go wrong: Gregorian month and year ends, leap days, the days around Ramadan and the Hijri new year in three Islamic calendar variants, Umm al-Qura month lengths, typed dates whose day/month order or calendar is ambiguous, instants that fall on different days in different zones, the same stored date displayed under different locales, calendars and numerals, and the first day of the week by country.

cases.note: Umm al-Qura months are 29 or 30 days by table, not by rule: a day 30 exists only in some months.

data.inputShape: { operation: toHijri | monthLengths | validate | parseTyped | localDateTime | format | weekInfo, … } with dates as ISO 8601 Gregorian YYYY-MM-DD
data.expectedShape: toHijri: { <calendar id>: { year, month, day } }; monthLengths: { months: [{ month, days, starts }], daysInYear }; validate: { valid }; parseTyped: { readings: [{ order, date }] } — more than one reading means the input is ambiguous; localDateTime: { <zone>: "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm" }; format: { long, short } with code points (ICU inserts direction marks in some patterns); weekInfo: { firstDay, weekend }.
